chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Duweyl, from Muqatil ibn Muqatil, who said:

I said to Al-Reza (peace be upon him), 'May I be sacrificed for you, teach me a supplication for fulfilling the needs.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'When you have an important need for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, then perform Ghusl, wear your cleanest clothes, and smell some perfume. Then go out beneath the sky and pray two Rak'at. Commence the prayer by reciting Fatihat al-Kitab (the Opening of the Book) and Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad (Say, He is Allah, One) fifteen times each.'
Then you bow (Ruku') and recite it fifteen times, then complete the prayer like the Prayer of Tasbih, except that the recitation is fifteen times. So when you give the Salam, recite it fifteen times.

Then you prostrate (Sajdah) and say in your prostration: 'O Allah, every worshipped entity from Your Throne to the settlement of Your earth is false except You, for You are Allah, the Evident Truth. Fulfill for me such and such a need. At this moment, at this moment,' and persist in what you desire.

key_terms.فَاتِحَةُ الْكِابِ: The Opening of the Book (Surah Al-Fatiha)
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Say, He is Allah, One (Surah Al-Ikhlas)

ai.seo_question: What is the ritual procedure for the prayer of fulfilling needs according to Imam Al-Reza?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith details a specific ritual prayer (Salat al-Hajah) prescribed by Imam Al-Reza (AS) for fulfilling urgent needs, emphasizing physical purification and spiritual focus. The practice involves performing Ghusl, wearing clean garments, and praying two Rak'at under the open sky, with repeated recitations of Surah Al-Fatiha and Surah Al-Ikhlas to affirm divine unity. The supplication concludes with a direct petition during prostration, highlighting the concept of 'Batil' (falsehood) of all other deities compared to Allah's absolute truth.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Duweyl, from Muqatil Bin Muqat who said,

‘I said to Al-Rezaasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! Teach me a supplication for fulfilling the needs’. So heasws said: ‘When there was an important need for you to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, so wash, and wear the cleanest of your clothes, and apply something from the perfume, then go out beneath the sky and pray two Rak’at of Salāt. You should commence the Salāt by reciting the Opening of the Book (Chapter 1), and [112:1] Say He Allah is One (Chapter 112) fifteen times.

Then you should go down into Rukū and recite it fifteen times, then complete them both like the Salāt of the Glorification (Tasbeeh), apart from that the recitation is fifteen times. So when you Salām, so recite it fifteen times.

Then perform Sajdah and you should be saying in your Sajdah, ‘O Allahazwj! It is false whatever is worshipped besides Youazwj, from Yourazwj Throne down to the settlement of Yourazwj earth, (Worship is only) for Youazwj, Youazwj are Allahazwj, The Evident Truth. Fulfil such and such a need of mine, at this moment, at this moment!’ and beg for what you want’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Duwayl from Muqatil ibn Muqatil who has said the following: “

I said to al-Rida, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, teach me a prayer for help in my needs.’ The Imam said, ‘When you need something and want Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, to help you, take a bath and dress up in your cleanest dress, use perfume, go under the open sky and perform two Rak‘at Salah (prayer). Begin Salah (prayer) and recite al-Fatihah and then Chapter 112 of the Holy Quran fifteen times.

Then kneel down for Ruku‘ and recite chapter 112 of the Holy Quran fifteen times. Thereafter complete this prayer like the Salah (prayer) of Tasbih discussed in Chapter 96 above, except that recitation in this Salah (prayer) is fifteen times. After Salam read Chapter 112 of the Holy Quran fifteen times.

Thereafter bow down for sajdah to say, “O Lord, everything, other than You, from Your Throne down to earth if worshipped is false. You are Allah in all truth and clarity. Please grant me such and such wish that I need, in this hour.” Strive to express your prayer as best as you can.”’
